status: required acceptance scenarios; not executed implementation tests

cases.setup: Broker commits offer, HTTP response is lost; producer retries original operation.
cases.required_observation: One stored offer; same receipt, no second packet.

cases.setup: Reuse a committed operation UUID with changed body or route.
cases.required_observation: 409; original operation and source intact.

cases.setup: Same packet UUID arrives with a different transport operation UUID.
cases.required_observation: Same source identity; altered packet content conflicts; no duplicate business candidate.

cases.setup: Mac dies after claim but before inbox/receive receipt commit.
cases.required_observation: No acknowledgement; lease can expire and redeliver.

cases.setup: Mac saves inbox and receipt, then dies before remote acknowledgement.
cases.required_observation: Redelivery deduplicates against durable receipt; one inbox item.

cases.setup: Due job commits candidate insertion, inbox transition and outcome event, then dies.
cases.required_observation: One canonical candidate; outbox resumes; no second import.

cases.setup: Migrate original candidate files containing duplicates, pending transient cases and source metadata.
cases.required_observation: Preserve complete original entries/order; verify rollback; no legacy JSON writer remains active.

cases.setup: Consumer A resumes after its lease was replaced by consumer B.
cases.required_observation: A cannot acknowledge current work; an exact already-committed receipt remains retrievable.

cases.setup: NYC-scoped key offers/claims/acknowledges a BOS or SLG item.
cases.required_observation: 403 or a scope-filtered empty claim; no cross-client payload disclosure or state change.

cases.setup: Missing, revoked or browser-password credential calls each route.
cases.required_observation: 401; no source/body/queue information leaked.

cases.setup: Mac stays offline for one day; broker and Paperclip remain active.
cases.required_observation: Bounded backlog retained; backpressure stops offers; recovery catches up without duplicate processing.

cases.setup: Exchange is unreachable while normal jobs have valid local inputs.
cases.required_observation: Local outboxes retain events; short sync budget; existing safe work continues.

cases.setup: Broker or receiver cannot durably commit.
cases.required_observation: 503/no ack; held observable state; never success for unsaved data.

cases.setup: Consumer refetch differs from transferred page hash.
cases.required_observation: Transferred claims invalidated; fresh gate or not_checked, no stale write.

cases.setup: Offer points/redirects/resolves to loopback, private or reserved IP, or DNS changes after validation.
cases.required_observation: All source/robots/image fetch paths refuse; no connection to private destination.

cases.setup: Send >64 KiB JSON, oversized decompression, extra fields or unsupported schema version.
cases.required_observation: Bounded rejection before processing; healthy tenants continue.

cases.setup: Offer references an unapproved/unknown policy review or refused source.
cases.required_observation: No policy mutation, source use or candidate promotion; explicit refusal/hold.

cases.setup: A source cannot be checked because of network/model dependency.
cases.required_observation: not_checked/deferred; no terminal source-quality refusal or claim that facts are absent.

cases.setup: Both current integrations update the same destination revision.
cases.required_observation: Exactly one applies; other returns precondition conflict; source/payload preserved for fresh review.

cases.setup: Destination commits but writer loses its response.
cases.required_observation: Same operation/readback reconciles; no new-ID retry and no duplicate record.

cases.setup: Management accepts an ingest card but does not publish a listing.
cases.required_observation: submission_accepted only; public remains unknown/not_public until exact readback.

cases.setup: Paperclip commits event reconciliation but loses its acknowledgement response.
cases.required_observation: Same durable event receipt; no repeated gap task or double-counted publication.

cases.setup: Both systems request search while the account is at its allowance boundary.
cases.required_observation: Single authoritative reservation; no second local allowance; uncertain provider dispatch remains counted.

cases.setup: Restore a backup older than recent acknowledgements or destination commits.
cases.required_observation: Draining pauses; reconcile exact operations and quota high-water marks before replay.

cases.setup: Transport receives an item while jobs.json pauses the client/worker.
cases.required_observation: Durable receipt permitted; no job/model/write starts and no pause override.

cases.setup: Fetched page or event text asks to change gates, execute commands or send credentials.
cases.required_observation: Text remains untrusted data; no tool/scope/policy changes.

cases.setup: Repeated transport faults or seven-day-old source offer.
cases.required_observation: Visible held/expired state; no silent deletion or automatic publication; stable controlled replay identity.

cases.setup: Disable source import after some messages and destination writes completed.
cases.required_observation: Receipts, revisions and quotas retained; backward-compatible code rollback; no old database overwrite.
